name: Valtteri Heikkinen
bio:
Valtteri Heikkinen's motorsport journey began not on the track, but in his father's engineering workshop in Jyväskylä. Surrounded by blueprints and engine parts from a young age, he developed a keen understanding of vehicle dynamics and a passion for competitive racing. After graduating with a degree in Mechanical Engineering from Aalto University, Valtteri quickly rose through the ranks at a smaller racing outfit, proving his managerial prowess and knack for optimizing performance.

His approach to being a Team Principal is rooted in meticulous planning and fostering a collaborative environment. Valtteri believes in empowering his team members, encouraging innovation, and leveraging data-driven insights to gain a competitive edge. He has a talent for identifying promising young talent and nurturing their potential. What sets Valtteri apart is his calm demeanor under pressure and his unwavering commitment to the team's success, often working late hours to ensure every detail is perfect.

physical.description: A tall, lean man with a serious but approachable demeanor.
